# `browser-extension/services/ConsequentialActionBudgetService.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/ConsequentialActionBudgetService.js`

Exact, expiring, single-use checkout authority for research-window actions. Page content cannot create or widen a budget. Only a trusted operator UI may issue one, and dispatch code must consume it before touching the page. Price, merchant, currency, item, cart, lease, document, or operator drift fails closed. A failed or unknown dispatch never restores consumed authority.
